summary: MU's pin is CORRECT and re-lands as a manual-tier anchor: ep 12 (the 2017 S1 finale, 'Don't Let Go of the Mic, Even if You Die' / 死んでもマイクを手放すな) ends on manga ch 29, vol 6. The episode title IS ch 29's title — Ichijinsha's own digital serialization prints 第29話「死んでもマイクを手放すな」 — and vol 6's TOC runs 24-29, so the anime finishes exactly on the volume's last chapter. MU's coverage string carries TWO labelled segments ('Vol 6, Chap 29 (S1) / Vol 10, Chap 49 (S2)'); our entry is S1-only and the stored value took the S1 segment, so no S2 leak (no G37). The surprise is a SKIP, not an original ending: the anime jumps ch 27 → 29 and never animates ch 28 「宴の終わり、後の祭」 (the 後夜祭 ball the ep-11 synopsis set up as the bet's prize) — es.fandom's per-episode list gives ep 12 = ch 26, 27, 29, and the official ep-12 synopsis has only the 打ち上げ/karaoke. I found NO support for the ask's 'anime-original epilogue' premise (the episodic reviewer who read the manga says the close was not anime-original), so no C1 and no divergence annotation — the continue is C5 post-series at ch 30 (vol 7) with ch 28 named as the unread hole. Chapter space: the stored 54 is a UNIT count (49 numbered mainline chapters in vols 1-10 + 4 half-numbered side chapters + vol 8's two-part ch 35); the number ceiling is 49, which is what latest_known already holds (N35 statement, no repair).

anchors.note: A4 END = 29, the last chapter of vol 6: the episode's title IS ch 29's title (Ichijinsha's digital serialization prints 第29話「死んでもマイクを手放すな」) and the content beat matches — the karaoke after-party contest (official synopsis: 打ち上げを開催するもカラオケ勝負に). Confirms MU's S1 segment 'Vol 6, Chap 29 (S1)' (G56: the pin is REDUNDANT, not wrong). A10 START = 26: es.fandom's per-episode list gives ch 26, 27, 29, and ep 11 ends mid-play (Class A performing with no prince, Masamune running to the stage) so ep 12 opens inside the Snow White block (Parts 4-5 = ch 26-27) — START is medium-confidence, END/volume are high (4 sources).

continue_points.note: C5: coverage per A4 is ch 29 (vol 6's last chapter, fully animated), so resume at ch 30 「巴里とオがつくマドモアゼル」 / 'The Wee Parisian Mademoiselle' (vol 7) — MU's other segment independently starts the second season at 'Vol 7, Chap 30'. FIRST read the one chapter this entry skipped: ch 28 「宴の終わり、後の祭」 (the 後夜祭 ball) is never animated in these 12 episodes — the anime jumps 27 → 29.

annotations.note: The episode adapts ch 26-27 (Yasaka Fest's Snow White Parts 4-5) then jumps straight to ch 29 (the karaoke contest): ch 28 「宴の終わり、後の祭」 — the 後夜祭 the ep-11 official synopsis sets up as the prize (後夜祭で愛姫と踊れるという勝負) — is not animated. es.fandom lists ep 12 = ch 26, 27, 29; the official and Bandai Channel synopses for ep 12 describe only the after-party karaoke, with the play results announced there instead of at the ball. Medium confidence on the exact skipped-page extent; the type stays canon (no anime-original block, T27/T28).

structure.notes:
CHAPTER SPACE (N35 statement, no repair): stored total_chapters=54 / latest_known=49 / 10 volumes. The 54 is a UNIT count, not a number ceiling. Summing the tankōbon TOCs of vols 1-10 gives exactly 54 entries — v1 4 (ch 1-4), v2 5 (5-9), v3 6 (9.5, 10, 11, 12, 12.5, 13), v4 6 (14, 14.5, 15-18), v5 6 (19, 20, 20.5, 21-23), v6 6 (24-29), v7 5 (30-34), v8 6 (ch 35 printed as Part 1 + Part 2, then 36-39), v9 5 (40-44), v10 5 (45-49) — i.e. 49 NUMBERED mainline chapters + 4 half-numbered side chapters + ch 35 counted twice. The mainline ceiling is 49 ('Dead or Love?', vol 10), which is exactly what latest_known holds and what MU's latest_chapter=49 and status '10 Volumes (Complete) + After School Volume (Complete)' say. Anchors must stay in this 1-49 space. (The wiki's Manga index page and its Volume_3 page disagree on whether vol 3's extra is 11.5 or 12.5; the COUNT is 6 either way. MangaDex's decimals — 4.5, 9.4, 13.5, 20.1/20.2, 23.5, 29.4/29.5 — are scanlator omake labels, not a numbering space.)
VOLUME BOUNDARIES (we store none; two sources agree — fandom volume TOCs + MangaDex's volume mapping): v1 1-4, v2 5-9, v3 9.5-13, v4 14-18, v5 19-23, v6 24-29, v7 30-34, v8 35-39, v9 40-44, v10 45-49. Ch 29 sits in v6 (matches the stored anchor's volume).
ADJACENT WORKS — do not let them into this space: vol 11 = 『政宗くんのリベンジ after school』, a separate short serialization whose 7 chapters both the fandom wiki and MangaDex number CONTINUOUSLY as 50-56 (MangaDex's series record therefore reads lastChapter 56 / lastVolume 11); vols 12-13 = 『政宗くんのリベンジ -engagement-』 (2023). ja-WP prints the line as 全13巻 for that reason. There is also a 新装版 (2023-24) that re-cuts the run into 7 volumes — a print re-edition, never an anchor space.
MU COVERAGE STRING (G32 segment discipline): anime.start = 'Vol 1, Chap 1 (S1) / Vol 7, Chap 30 (S2)', anime.end = 'Vol 6, Chap 29 (S1) / Vol 10, Chap 49 (S2)'. This entry is the 12-episode 2017 S1 only (Masamune-kun's Revenge R is a separate entry), so the correct segment is the (S1) one. The stored pin took it correctly — the (S2) value did NOT leak, so there is no G37 defect here; the pin is simply now corroborated and manual.
EPISODE↔CHAPTER TITLE LINE (S1, title=title, for orientation): ep 1 豚足と呼ばれた男 = ch 1; ep 2 シンデレラは笑わない = ch 2; ep 3 吉乃のマジックショー = ch 4; ep 4 今そこにある危機 = ch 7; ep 5 ミステリアス・キャット = ch 8; ep 6 突撃!お宅訪問戦 = ch 12; ep 7 綱手島事件 = ch 13; ep 8 君じゃないんだ = ch 16; ep 9 愛とも恋ともいうけれど = ch 18; ep 10 疑惑の新学期 = ch 19; ep 11 八坂祭の白雪姫 = ch 23; ep 12 死んでもマイクを手放すな = ch 29. Every S1 episode takes its title from a chapter inside its own range, and the range END is the title chapter for ep 12. Rows 1-11 were out of scope for this task and take no anchors from it.
WIKI FIELD CAUTION: the English wiki's per-episode 'chapters' field is populated for only 6 of 12 rows and is not consistently START or END (ep 11 = 'Chapter 22' = that row's START; ep 12 = 'Chapter 29' = that row's END). The Spanish wiki mirrors the English rows 1-4 verbatim but carries independently-added ranges on eps 6, 7, 10, 11, 12 — treat it as ONE wiki family with an extra editor, which is why ep 12's START is called medium and not high.

flags_for_sean: PIN VERDICT: CONFIRMED (case 1). ep 12 → ch 29, vol 6 is right; the MU row can be re-landed at the manual tier with the citations above. No G37 — MU's S2 segment ('Vol 10, Chap 49 (S2)') did not leak into our S1-only entry.

ASK PREMISE NOT CONFIRMED: 'the finale ends mid-chapter with an anime-original close'. No source I could reach says so. Random Curiosity's episodic reviewer, answering a reader who asked exactly this ('Was this an anime-original thing…?'), replies 'As far as I know this was not anime original, just a convenient location to end the arc' (archived 2025-02-14 snapshot of randomc.net/2017/03/23/masamune-kun-no-revenge-12-end/), and the episode stops on vol 6's last chapter — a volume boundary, not a straddle. So: no C1, no divergence annotation, C5 post-series at 30. If a page-level source for an original epilogue exists, this is the one value to revisit (it would move the continue from 30 into 29).

The REAL finding is the skip, not the ending: ch 28 「宴の終わり、後の祭」 is never animated by this entry, and MU's own S2 segment starts the sequel at 'Vol 7, Chap 30' — so ch 28 appears to be skipped by the FRANCHISE, not just by S1. Worth checking on the Masamune-kun's Revenge R entry when its turn comes (its ep 1 = ch 30 by title, 巴里とオがつくマドモアゼル).

ep 12 START = 26 is MEDIUM (one wiki source + the ep-11 handoff beat); END = 29 and volume = 6 are HIGH (fandom episode infobox, Ichijinsha's Comic Days chapter title, vol 6 TOC, MU's S1 segment, official synopsis content beat). If the display should not show a medium START, drop start_chapter and keep chapters_adapted as the note.

N35: total_chapters 54 is a unit count (49 mainline numbers + 4 half-numbered side chapters + ch 35's two printed parts). latest_known 49 is the honest number ceiling and needs no change; nothing in the catalog should ever anchor above 49 in this space.
The catalog stores 0 volume boundaries for this series; the v1-v10 table in structure.notes is two-source and ready to ingest if wanted.
